member.name: M:Roblox.YouTube.VideoItem.ParseDuration(System.String)
member.summary: Parses a from a YouTube duration value.
member.remarks:
"duration": "P3W3DT20H31M21S" 3 weeks, 3 days, 20 hours, 31 minutes, 21 seconds Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=04cF1m6Jxu8 Timestamp pieces will be left out as they do not apply (e.g. seconds will not be included if it the video duration is exactly on a whole minute)
Right now this method does not support durations of a day or more, if we ever need to we can add this support.
member.returns: The (will be if duration cannot be parsed.)
